This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Make It Stop" />

==Biology and appearance==
This diminutive bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|pale]], fleshy appearances, with white [[hair]], elongated heads, pointed [[ear]]s, and large [[nose]]s.<ref name="Make It Stop" />

==Species in the galaxy==
Sometime between [[18 BBY]] and [[15 BBY]], a member of this species was present on a [[planet]] visited by [[Luthen Rael]] and [[Kleya Marki]].<ref name="Make It Stop" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Nose-Species-Silicone-Bust-Mask.png|right|100px|thumb|One of the silicone bust masks created by Sophie Rechtberger]]
The species made their debut in the [[Make It Stop|tenth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']],<ref name="Make It Stop" /> directed by [[Alonso Ruizpalacios]] and aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]],<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref> while the original silicon bust mask used for this species in the series were modeled by [[Sophie Rechtberger]].<ref name="Rechtberger">{{WebCite|url=http://sophierechtberger.com/silicone-busts-masks|text=SOPHIE RECHTBERGER|work=[http://sophierechtberger.com SOPHIE RECHTBERGER]|archivedate=20250518022123}}</ref> and built by [[Matt Hart]]. On the set for Andor Season 2, this alien was nicknamed "Boris," being performed by [[Lauren King]] and puppeteered by [[Claire Roi Harvey]].<ref name="Puppeteer">{{Instagram|username=matt.hart87|url=p/DJpk-MctJ4c|name=[[Matt Hart]]|date=2025-05-14|quote=Well, the wait was worth it, what a great show and a pleasure to work on.
I feel like the majority of my work on this was on set, but managed to build a few heads too, which all appeared! I even got my first puppeteer credit for the Cyclops I built!! (Despite also puppeteering a senator earlier in the series...) In 2023, I also had a great trip with the CFX team to Valencia to shoot a load of great content at the impressive Museo de las Ciencias Príncipe Felipe. 1. Cyclops - I meched and puppeteered, performed by the amazing @cavincornwall 2. Boris - I meched and was performed by the amazing @lauren97king and puppeteered on set by the equally amazing @claireroiharvey. This guy should have had more screen time! 3. 'Elvis' the dog - I meched the head and @ashflash_26 meched the body, was a rushed build and looked great when we finished it. Shout-out to @cerinaknott for the late night we all did to get it over the line. Performed by the brilliant @wimoppenheimer and @neilsterenbergpuppeteer On to the next job with a bunch of incredible people 🤘|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/qKe9G}}</ref>
